@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: Three cells of raised dots spell the number for a reader who never sees it. The dots rise in sequence; hover to feel the page again.

meta.note: The number is built from seven-segment hardware, one bar at a time. Every unlit segment stays visible as a faint idea of the digit.

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: The dead end arrives as a paper receipt: four line items, a total of 404.00 and a stamp that settles the matter. Hover and the stamp presses down.

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: No ink was used. The number is debossed into dark stock and read only by a raking light that drifts across the surface.

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: Three mismatched cuts of paper carry one digit each, taped down at slightly wrong angles. Hover and the paste-up snaps into line.

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: A barcode carries the number in bars, and a scan line keeps checking. The digits sit above the code like a price tag for something that does not exist.

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: Registration marks, trim lines and a colour bar frame the number like a press proof. Hover and the guides fall away, leaving the solid print.

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: A rotary dial that takes 4, 0, then 4. Pull it round, let it spring back, and the readout keeps score. The correct number still gets no answer.

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: Three digits hang from a rail on strings of different lengths. Move across the card and they swing; leave and gravity takes its time.

items.name: lost-404
items.title: Lost Property 404
items.description: Four things nobody came back for
items.author: 404lab

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: A paper intake sheet for a site that misplaced exactly one page and found four other things. Hover a tag, tap an item, and it does its small party trick: the umbrella shakes, the watch restarts, the key turns, the plane takes a lap. Log all four and the sheet closes anyway.

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: A working breakout wall built from one four and two zeros. Move the paddle, keep the ball alive and take the number down one brick at a time. Whatever was behind it is not the page either.

items.name: punch-404
items.title: Punch Card 404
items.description: Punch it out, one cell at a time
items.author: 404lab

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: The number is printed on a data card and every filled cell is a hole waiting to happen. Punch all thirty-four and the card voids itself. A crosshair follows the row and the column so the cut stays square.

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: A dark sector, a stencilled number and a single eye set where the zero should be. The pupil follows the pointer, the lid closes when you click, and the watch log keeps changing its mind about what it saw.

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: An engraved plate of nine flowers under a number that never grew. Move across the page and each flower opens as you come near. Tap one to hold it open and the register counts it.

meta.note: A dashed template frame that draws itself as you sweep across it. Guides, navigation, a hero with the number and three empty columns. Sweep back and the whole layout comes apart again.

items.name: setting-out-404

items.description: Drag the measure, set the number
items.author: 404lab

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: A paper plane on a hill above a long drop. Hold anywhere to pull it back, release to throw and watch it land somewhere that still is not the page. Three throws, one measured arc.

items.name: snake-404
items.title: Snake 404
items.description: Nine pellets on a dead grid
items.author: 404lab

@utility display.font-family: var(--lab-font-display, var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif))

meta.note: A hidden snake game on a field notebook plate. Arrow keys, W A S D or a swipe steer the head, nine pellets close the register, and hitting the frame or your own tail ends the run. The page is not on the board either.
